articles.summary: Olispania has selected Sonoco’s Orbit® closure for its jarred products, reducing opening torque by up to 50%. The collaboration received Gold in the Editor’s Choice category at the Packaging News Sustainability and Impact Awards 2026.
articles.title: Olispania Brings Inclusive Design to Its Olive Jars with Sonoco’s Orbit®

articles.summary: At Sonoco, we believe our responsibility extends beyond producing sustainable packaging. Throughout the company, we support the communities in which we live and work through focused, intentional giving and volunteer efforts. As our guiding principle states, ‘people build businesses by doing the right thing,’ and we’re doing our part to strengthen the children and families who live within our surrounding communities.
articles.title: Putting Responsibility Into Action: Sonoco Invests in Local Youth Mentorship Programs
